tiktok.author: jayceeluvz
tiktok.body:
Apple—your days are numbered 🗣️🗣️ #rant #apple #subscriptions
Apple is allowing something that I think should be absolutely illegal, or at least should be, like, regulated in some sort of way. I am sick and tired of an app being free to download, but basically every usable feature, every feature that you would want to download the app for is a paid feature. And it's always a freaking subscription. It's always a subscription. I'm sick and tired of them. But what I think we need to do, I need Congress to get their shit together, get rid of the president, let's get a new president. And then we need to start on these things, okay? We need to start I want there to be a list of the free features and a free list of the paid features and what tier they're at, how much that actually cost. Okay, like if it's a language learning app and it's free to download, but basically all the free features are crap, and then all the paid features are what are actually gonna help you learn. I wanna know that before I download it. I don't wanna have to go through the rigmarole of downloading it and then finding out that it's actually just a crap app unless you pay for it. Also, I'm sick and I. Let's go back again to the subscriptions. I'm sick and tired of everything being a subscription. What happened to purchasing something once? What happened? I'm tired Of the subscription model. Literally, kiss my ass. It's so over. It's so tired. Everything's on a subscription. So much so that people are making apps that will find the subscriptions and cancel them for you. And guess what? Rocket money. Also a subscription. The hell is up with that? I've had it. Anyway, that's that.
